marc:datafield.marc:subfield: How did I get here? finding your way to renewed hope and happiness when life and love take unexpected turns

Everyone, at one time or another, faces the unexpected and asks "How did I get here?" Whether because of disappointments in love, crises in health, family or finances, or professional dissatisfaction, life sometimes fails to meet our expectations. Renowned inspirational teacher Barbara De Angelis offers the listener timeless teachings and innovative techniques such as how to recognize turning points, transform fear into courage, and reclaim passion in love and life.
